text: Brent crude fell 7.7% to $104.66; WTI declined 7.3% to $96.50. U.S. and Iranian officials expressed openness to negotiations. Military escalation remains undecided, with sanctions, regional military presence, blockade conditions, and tanker attacks unresolved.

meta.note: Diplomatic statements and military readiness coexist without a confirmed agreement or operational change.

text: Anthropic reported Q3 revenue of $17 billion (+1,127% YoY), a $23.29 billion net loss, and $895.4 billion in purchase and lease commitments, primarily for compute and infrastructure. Quarterly revenue growth was 47%, versus 144% in Q2. Nine-month revenue totaled $33.24 billion.

meta.note: Reported net losses include convertible-note and derivative-liability fair-value adjustments.

text: The DOJ petitioned the Supreme Court to restrict counting approximately 20,000 disputed California mail-in ballots. District and appellate courts denied federal intervention. Voter citizenship claims remain unadjudicated, with state ballot-counting procedures intact.

meta.note: Citizenship allegations remain unverified; Supreme Court action is pending.

text: Apple reported Q4 revenue of $114.48 billion (+12% YoY), EPS of $2.10, and gross margin of 47.9%, down from approximately 50% in Q3. iPhone and Mac revenue rose 17% and 24%; iPad and accessories declined. December-quarter gross margin guidance was 45%-46%.

meta.note: Reported gross margin includes approximately one percentage point from tariff refunds.

text: The Supreme Court denied the DOJ's emergency request to block counting approximately 20,000 disputed California mail-in ballots. The unsigned order noted no dissents or explanation. Lower-court rulings remain operative, with state ballot-counting procedures intact.

meta.note: Denial resolves the emergency request, not the underlying citizenship allegations or litigation.
